content: Hello, I am Cedar Insurance's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Robin Hale?
Yes, this is Robin Hale speaking.
Thank you, Mx Hale. Before we continue, I need to verify your identity. Could you please tell me your policyholder code?
Thank you, that's confirmed. Next, could you please tell me your postcode?
Thank you, you're fully verified. I'm calling about your insurance policy, which currently shows an overdue premium of 480 euros and is 8 days late. Are you able to pay the full 480 today?
No, I can't pay the full amount today, I'm afraid. Also, did you mean pounds rather than euros? I've only got 120 pounds I can put toward it right now.

I apologise, I shouldn't have named a currency, as my system shows only the amount: 480 in your policy's billing currency, as on your statement. I'm unable to record 120, as the lowest amount I can accept is 160. Could you pay 160 today? Please note the remaining balance of 320 would still be overdue.
I'm sorry, but I can't do 160. I only have 120 available until a client pays me, which might be around the twentieth, but that isn't guaranteed, so I don't want to promise money I haven't got.

I understand, and I appreciate you not wanting to promise money you don't have. The 20th would be beyond the latest date I can accept for this policy, which is Friday the 16th of October. Would you be able to pay the minimum of 160 tomorrow, Thursday the 15th of October? The remaining 320 would still be overdue.

No, I'm sorry, tomorrow wouldn't change anything. I'll still only have 120 until at least the twentieth, and even that depends on the client paying. If 120 isn't something you can accept, I'll have to leave it there for now rather than agree to something I can't cover.

I understand, and thank you for being honest with me. I haven't recorded any promise today, and the 480 remains overdue on your insurance policy. If your situation changes, please use the official contact channel on your statement. Thank you for your time, Mx Hale. Goodbye.
Thanks for understanding. I'll get in touch through the official channel if the client payment comes through. Goodbye.
